SELECT IFID , IF_NM , IF_DESC , ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '110' AND CODE = IF_PROCESS_TYPE_CD ) AS IF_PROCESS_TYPE_CD , ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '109' AND CODE = IF_CONNECTION_TYPE_CD ) AS IF_CONNECTION_TYPE_CD , RULE_USE_YN , DOC_LENGTH , CHARACTERSET , EAIID , ( SELECT LGON_ID FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID = FIRSTREG_USERID ) AS FIRSTREG_USERID , ( SUBSTR(FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS FIRSTREG_DATETIME , ( SELECT LGON_ID FROM CLOVER_USER WHERE USER_ID = UPDATE_USERID ) AS UPDATE_USERID , ( SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME FROM INTERFACEINFO
DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT A.IFID , A.FIELD_ENG_NM , A.FIELD_KOR_NM , A.FIELD_ORDER , A.FIELD_LENGTH , A.FIELD_START_NO , A.FIELD_CODE_TYPE , ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM CLOVER_CODE WHERE CODE_TYPE = '108' AND CODE = A.DATATYPE_CD ) AS DATATYPE_CD , A.FIELD_SCALE , A.TRIM_YN , A.CHARACTERSET , A.FIRSTREG_USERID , ( SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.FIRSTREG_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS FIRSTREG_DATETIME , A.UPDATE_USERID , ( SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 1, 4) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 5, 2) || '/' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 11, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(A.UPDATE_DATETIME, 13, 2) ) AS UPDATE_DATETIME , B.IF_NM FROM INTERFACEMAP A , INTERFACEINFO B
